sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically verified: the lowerIceWaterline candidate is an xsd:string datatype property rather than a metre-valued QuantityValue relationship, while iceWaterline is only a generic Class and does not provide the required owner-correct waterline value semantics.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Make the draught, ice-class, and upper/lower-waterline constraints conditional on the declared applicability selector: ships with shipIceStrengthened=true must satisfy all required inputs and comparisons, while shipIceStrengthened=false must not be forced to provide them; missing selector evidence must still violate. The current unconditional minCount constraints reject non-applicable ships. Also replace the presence-only waterline and ice-class checks with the required relationship semantics linking the ice-class draught bounds and fore/aft operating draughts to the upper and lower ice waterlines; merely requiring nodes of the declared classes does not encode “determined in accordance with” those waterlines. Preserve the existing ship ownership, metre QuantityValue structure, and inclusive fore/aft bound comparisons.

The applicability conditional, ship ownership, metre QuantityValue structures, and inclusive fore/aft comparisons are preserved, but the required waterline relationship remains only presence/type validation. The SPARQL query binds upperWaterline and lowerWaterline without reading any waterline draught values or otherwise linking those waterlines to the minimum and maximum ice-class draughts, so it does not encode “determined in accordance with” the upper/lower ice waterlines or the ship draught being between them. Locate the canonical waterline value/relationship term(s) absent from the scoped vocabulary, then add owner-correct constraints and comparison logic using those terms while retaining the true-selector branch and missing-selector violation.
